capabilities: Toggle a note's page width between default and wide
Keep width settings per note without touching vault-wide readable line length
Trigger the toggle from ribbon, command palette, editor right-click, or more-options menu
Apply a narrow (560px) class manually via cssclasses in frontmatter
extras: Ships a companion CSS snippet (page-width.css) that must be installed separately into the snippets folder and enabled in Appearance settings; beta installs go through the BRAT plugin. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's readable line length setting applies vault-wide, so a single note cannot be made wider without changing every note.
summary: Per-note page width toggle that switches a note between Obsidian's default width and a wide mode via ribbon, command, right-click, or more-options menu.
